# MarketCentaur

> MarketCentaur provides marketing and growth support for B2B and B2C businesses, with a focus on B2B growth intelligence and account-based marketing.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://marketcentaur.com/): Overview of services and working approach.
- [About](https://marketcentaur.com/about.html): MarketCentaur's approach to growth intelligence.
- [Services](https://marketcentaur.com/#services): Strategy, ABM, demand generation, content, digital growth, market intelligence and AI-assisted marketing operations.
- [B2C services](https://marketcentaur.com/#b2c-services): Brand, social content, SEO, campaign support, ecommerce conversion, email, retention and customer research.
- [FAQs](https://marketcentaur.com/faq.html): Answers about services, audience, process and outcomes.
- [Contact](https://marketcentaur.com/contact.html): Business inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://marketcentaur.com/privacy-policy.html): Website information handling.
- [Terms of Service](https://marketcentaur.com/terms-of-service.html): Website use terms.

## Summary
MarketCentaur supports B2B and B2C businesses with marketing strategy, account-based marketing, demand generation, content marketing, SEO, market and competitive research, conversion optimization, retention strategy and AI-assisted workflows. B2B growth intelligence focuses on ICP fit, target-account research, relevant stakeholders, buying signals and practical next actions.

This file is a navigational summary, not a replacement for the linked pages. Site content and service descriptions are authoritative over this summary.
